title: Ace Trial power requirements cut again; auto-gather targets expand
summary: Ace Trial power requirements drop again across every ladder, in places to a small fraction of the previous figure, and ladder 4's entire 300-row power curve is rescaled. Auto-gather adds a new target, the ruins power inhibit threshold doubles, and two X Spark Cards plus Dojo and auto-gather art are registered.
highlights: Ace Trial: the first seven stages of every ladder fall in required power, for example 150,000 to 9,000 and 1,050,000 to 600,000.
ruins_new_stage_4's power curve is rescaled across all 300 rows, 260 up and 7 down, at 0.064x to 1.067x the previous value.
ruins_challenge_new raises its power inhibit threshold from [-0.99,5] to [-0.99,10] and adds four entries to the amigo attribute bonus list, now 12.
Auto-gather adds target type 232, with a matching reward entry.
Two new X Spark Card items (#900282 and #900283) are registered.
New art: three Dojo speech bubbles, plus fourteen auto-gather panel backgrounds, monster portraits and reward frames.
